description: SDS trust-enforcement hold. No VC issuer, JWK, trust anchor, credential status-list endpoint, or automated VC authorization is published or active.

runtimeEnforcement.reason: No runtime VC verifier or approved issuer-key provenance and custody evidence exists. Historical placeholder issuer records and unusable JWKs were removed rather than represented as trust anchors.
runtimeEnforcement.activationPrerequisite: A per-issuer custody decision package, verified DID-document provenance, usable JWK with kid/thumbprint, status-list procedure, rotation and revocation evidence, explicit approval, and fail-closed runtime verification tests.

rotationPolicy.activationGate: No issuer can be added while runtimeEnforcement.status is not_activated.
rotationPolicy.futureCompromiseResponse: immediate revocation and runtime denial after activation
